messages:
Ana: Quick brain dump idea: replace wide onboarding banner with a compact 'Starter' pill in the right rail that expands into a contextual checklist. Less chrome, same surface. Thoughts? Maya: I like declutter. Concern: small orgs and PMs might miss it. Maybe show full banner only for single-seat orgs and use the pill for multi-seat orgs. Dylan: From infra perspective, Dedicated/private orgs need an alternate flow (upload template). We should not show hosted samples to them. Could the pill swap to 'Upload template' when flags indicate offline mode? Sam: Accessibility checklist: when pill expands, move focus into the new region, set aria-expanded on the control, and announce the panel. Use an aria-live polite region for import success messages. Olivia: Figma mock: https://figma.com/file/xyz321/compact-starter-rail shows collapsed pill, expanded checklist, and mobile fallback (full-width). I'll add the aria notes. aria-bot: Accessibility suggestions: add role="region" and aria-label to expanded panel; toggle button should have aria-expanded and aria-controls; ensure visible focus ring and >= 4.5:1 contrast for CTAs in all themes. Sam: Reusable snippet we can drop into PR: ```html
  • Step 1: Create workspace
  • Step 2: Add starter app
``` Ana: Copy note: research shows PMs prefer 'Start from template', devs prefer 'Add sample', ops like 'Apply workspace template'. Propose role-aware labels and a copy map. Maya: Let's A/B test label + placement. Experiment: EXP-999 with variants: rail-pill vs top-banner and copy variants (template/sample/starter). Dylan: Telemetry keys: control_surface (rail|banner), label_variant (template|sample|starter), customer_mode (hosted|dedicated|private). I'll wire this into events. events-bot: Noted: EXP-999 created and linked to board. Tracking keys: control_surface,label_variant,customer_mode. Sam: Accessibility follow-ups: keyboard users need skip link back to main content after finishing a step. Also avoid single-letter shortcuts; surface actions via command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K). Olivia: I'll prototype the expand animation and ensure focus trap is not used (we prefer in-page region). Mobile fallback will be full-width CTA that scrolls to checklist. Ana: Microcopy proposal for first-timers: CTA = 'Add starter app' with helper text 'Installs a demo app into your workspace'. For PMs show 'Start from template' + helper 'Starter apps and integrations'. Maya: Action items: Olivia update Figma with ARIA & copy matrix; Dylan add telemetry; Sam write a11y acceptance criteria for the PR; Ana draft experiment notes and user segments; Maya coordinate usability tests for Thursday. Sam: Small accessibility reminder: update the acceptance checklist to require SR announcement tests in both light/dark themes. Olivia: Will do. Will post updated mock and a short prototype link when ready. Maya: Thanks team. Quick win: hide full-width banner for users who already selected a starter during signup. :+1:
